Sam: Quick check — ACME is ready to start the POC. They want 3 product engineers with temporary access (hosted API keys) and 1 infra engineer who needs Dedicated pool admin rights. Who owns the least-privilege mapping and short-lived credential flow?
Priya: Short answer: hosted API keys = workspace-scoped keys you can restrict by scope/expiry. For devs we usually give a Developer role (generate + read). For the infra person we create a service account with pool_admin. SSO can be added later via SCIM.
Max: For least-privilege config I recommend: Developer = inference.generate + embeddings.read, no billing. Pool_admin = pool.deploy + pool.scale + logs.view. Example service-account policy snippet: ```roles: ["workspace.developer"] scopes: ["inference.generate"] expiry_hours: 72```
Tara: On the Private/VPC side — we need their customer CIDR allowlist and the egress IPs they'll whitelist. Note: Dedicated pools are in our managed VPC by default; if they want a customer-dedicated VPC we treat that as Private deployment and lead time is ~2-3 weeks.
deploy-bot: Dedicated pool provisioning ETA: 3-5 business days after signed order and subnet confirmation.
Sam: Can someone give a ballpark pricing difference for a small Dedicated GPU pool vs hosted usage over 30 days? They asked for an estimate to include in their internal approval.
Priya: Ballpark only: hosted pay-as-you-go depends on tokens/throughput; estimate sent to DM. Dedicated small (reserved) usually amortizes lower per-token cost but requires commit. I'll provide a short example calc (30d) in the DM.
Max: Action items: (1) Priya — send role mapping + example invite link, (2) Tara — send VPC checklist + required IP ranges and certs, (3) Sam — confirm the 3 dev + 1 infra list and timeline, (4) Max — prep an ephemeral-key script for devs and example rotation policy.
Sam: Also, ACME's security team sent a short questionnaire that asks about API key rotation, KMS, and audit logs. Who owns the answers?
Tara: Security/ops should own KMS/HSM + audit retention specifics. I can draft answers for the questionnaire and tag security for review.
Sam: Great. Priya — can you create an invite token with a 7-day expiry and post it here (or DM the link to ACME)? They prefer short-lived invites.
Priya: On it, will post the invite link + the minimal role mapping doc here when done. :thumbsup:
Max: I'll drop the ephemeral-key script in the thread once Priya posts the invite, so they can test without exposing long-lived creds.
Sam: Thanks all — we'll loop back after the checklist items are in.
